Executive who expanded Starbucks on an Italian-bar model.

How Howard Schultz connects

  • Faction: Starbucks — Howard Schultz expanded Starbucks on an Italian espresso-bar model.
  • Location: Italian coffee bar — Schultz has said Milan's bars inspired the Starbucks espresso format.

What is Howard Schultz?

Howard Schultz pushed Starbucks from a bean counter toward espresso bars after seeing Milan, then scaled that theater worldwide.
